}}'''Serenia Latar''' was the [[Amyrlin Seat]] from [[276 NE|276]] to {{Ne|306}}. She was raised from the [[Gray Ajah]].{{ref|{{bwb}}, Chapter 24 The White Tower|Serenia}}

{{quote|Serenia Latar being raised on the scaffold, the only Amyrlin the Children had ever managed to hang.  She had been dead already, of course, live witches being somewhat hard to hang, but that was beside the point. Six hundred and ninety-three years ago, justice had been done according to the law.|Musings of [[Eamon Valda]] in the Dome of Truth{{ref/book|6|31}}}}

== History ==
She was [[Comarra Zepava]]'s successor and [[Doniella Alievin]]'s predecessor.{{ref||Serenia}}

She was a strong Amyrlin who increased the [[White Tower|Tower]]'s influence and prestige. Her skillful negotiations ended many wars and effected many treaties.

She died in [[Altara]] after negotiating the end of a civil war there. Somehow her corpse was seized by [[Whitecloaks]] who hanged it as a final affront.

Her image at the gallows decorates an alcove in the [[Dome of Truth]] in the form of fresco
